t: 大卫四世国王手下的格鲁吉亚军队战胜了著名的塞尔柱克指挥官伊尔加齐,取得了决定性的胜利.
te: The Georgian army under King David IV wins a decisive victory over the famous Seljuk commander Ilghazi.

de: Battle of Didgori: The Georgian army under King David IV wins a decisive victory over the famous Seljuk commander Ilghazi.
